meta.notes: demand=underlying(gross grid demand + est rooftop gen, app nets rooftop internally). wind_pu/solar_pu are per-unit of nameplate, so app energy = installed_MW*sum(pu).
meta.csp_source: Eskom normalised CSP feed-in (MW/MW), calendar year 2021, via PyPSA-RSA data/eskom_pu_profiles.csv. Replaces an earlier synthetic evening-shifted Gaussian which produced ZERO output before 10:00 - real SA CSP is already at ~50% by 09:00 because it runs off stored heat.
meta.wind_source_updated: Capacity-weighted composite from real regional profiles (Renewables.ninja MERRA-2, calendar year 2023), weighted by existing REIPPPP plant capacity per region from regional_renewable_capacity.json. Replaces the Eskom ESK19243 2025 national aggregate which used a single-point national profile.
meta.solar_source_updated: Capacity-weighted composite from real regional profiles (Renewables.ninja MERRA-2, calendar year 2023), weighted by existing REIPPPP plant capacity per region from regional_renewable_capacity.json. Replaces the Eskom ESK19243 2025 national aggregate which used a single-point national profile.
